game_title: Strip And Replace – Frozen Waterfall Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall, a frozen waterfall: the rescue climber must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall: a frozen waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Waterfall, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the radio mast using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the radio mast is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Frozen Waterfall'. region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Frozen Waterfall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 19.
